In the 19th minute, Harry Leonard restored parity with a clinical finish from close range. The momentum stayed with the hosts, and by the 27th minute, they had turned the game around as Danny Ormerod headed home a pinpoint Harley Mills cross to make it 2-1. Barnsley were far from finished, though. Just before the break, a swift counter-attack orchestrated by Arley Kay found Reyes Cleary , who slotted the ball into the bottom corner to level the scores at 2-2. It was a fitting end to a first half defined by relentless attacking intent from both teams. Late Resilience and Penalty Heartbreak The second half mirrored the intensity of the first. Leading 3-2, Barnsley looked poised for the next round, but Peterborough had one final response. In the 88th minute, the Harley Mills and Danny Ormerod connection struck again, with the latter heading in a dramatic equalizer to force a penalty shootout. In the ensuing lottery, both teams displayed remarkable composure from the spot. After a marathon sequence of successful strikes, the deadlock was finally broken when Peterborough goalkeeper Alex Bass dived correctly to deny Luke Alker . Harrison Jones then stepped up to convert the winning penalty, securing a 7-6 shootout victory for the Posh after a 3-3 draw in regulation time.
